abstract.text: Share a Project when other people need to see and work with the same places and Activities.

inlineContent.text: Open the Project’s collaboration tools to send a LinkMap invitation or show its QR code. A collaborator can open the invitation or use Dashboard → Scan. After joining, they can select the shared Project in Context.
When sharing ends, collaborators no longer see the Project after refreshing their Project list.

abstract.text: Learn how to organize places and work in LinkMap on iOS and the web.
